summary: Frontend-only validation that the multi-select behaviour from the Biblioteca tab now also works on the Pexels and Selección (pexels-selection) tabs of the Image Library inside Galerías. All 7 acceptance bullets pass: toggle-on-click (no immediate import), check badge + ring, footer counter+'Añadir N imágenes'+'Limpiar', 'Añadiendo…' loading state while imports run, modal closes after add, day's thumb count grows by exactly the number selected per tab, tab-switch resets selection, Biblioteca regression still works, cleanup removed all 6 added thumbs. Zero JS console errors. The iteration-36 i18n nit ('IMAGENES' missing tilde) is ALSO fixed — button now reads 'AÑADIR 2 IMÁGENES'.

consistency_check: PASS — selection UX (toggle-on-click, bottom-right check badge, ring highlight, subtitle/footer counter, 'Añadir N imágenes' button, 'Limpiar' clear button) is identical across Biblioteca / Pexels / Selección. Difference is correctly localised to the import step: Pexels and Selección show 'AÑADIENDO…' for ~1–3 s while POST /api/pexels/import runs per selected photo; Biblioteca closes instantly. selectedMap is independent per tab — switching tabs resets selection so hosted and to-import items can never be mixed in a single add.

i18n_fix_confirmed: iteration_36 reported the button rendered 'AÑADIR 3 IMAGENES' (missing tilde). This iteration confirms the label now reads 'AÑADIR 2 IMÁGENES' with the correct Spanish tilde. Singular 'AÑADIR 1 IMAGEN' and zero-state 'AÑADIR IMÁGENES' also correct.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageLibraryPicker.jsx — SELECTION_TABS = ['library','pexels','pexels-selection']; selectionMode = multiple && onSelectMany && SELECTION_TABS.includes(tab). Clean extension of the iteration-36 design. The two reset effects (on close AND on tab change) correctly prevent mixing hosted + to-import items.

confirmSelection() fast-paths the Biblioteca case (no _needsImport items → calls onSelectMany synchronously, no 'Añadiendo…' flicker). Pexels/Selección path sets adding=true, iterates items, POSTs /api/pexels/import per item, tolerates single-item import failures (try/catch around each fetch, push only on r.ok && j.url), and emits onSelectMany once with the resolved array. Single PUT /day-galleries/<key> via GalleryManager.onPickManyFromLibrary follows — matches the spec.

PexelsTab + PexelsSelectionTab accept selectionMode/selectedKeys/onToggleSelect symmetrically. In selectionMode the button onClick calls onToggleSelect({_key:`pexels-${id}` | `pexels-selection-${id}`, _pexelsId, _needsImport:true, ...}) instead of the legacy importPhoto flow. aria-pressed reflects state. Single-pick fallback (when not in selectionMode) is preserved for callers that pass only onSelect.

Minor — the *-check-<id> badge element is ALWAYS rendered in selectionMode (its visual state changes via className based on `selected`). That's intentional for the hover-affordance and is fine, but means a test cannot use 'badge element existence' as a selection check; tests must inspect the className or the footer counter. Worth noting for future testing agents.
